judge.text: - The `get_my_assigned_workorders` permit also allows requests that omit `open_only`, because the condition is `if context.input has open_only then … == true else true`. The intent allows only *open* work orders assigned to a technician. If the tool treats a missing `open_only` as "include closed", the policy exposes closed work orders. The policy should require `context.input has open_only && context.input.open_only == true`.
